raw_result: {"facts": [{"item_id": "355b9ff70aa64eedb2d82100e018c18f::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Breadcrumbs are additional request-response cycle visibility data."}, {"item_id": "e4503d4c6355480dad509d939c33f227::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "The Manual Actions report shows any manual-action issues."}, {"item_id": "e4503d4c6355480dad509d939c33f227::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "The Manual Actions report shows the affected site section."}, {"item_id": "e4503d4c6355480dad509d939c33f227::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "The Manual Actions report shows where to learn more."}, {"item_id": "26a77c5d0ec54a4ba329de7660d3c4a6::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "The relevance metric assigns high, medium, or low to whole answers."}, {"item_id": "26a77c5d0ec54a4ba329de7660d3c4a6::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "The relevance metric includes a binary highlighted-most-relevant judgment."}, {"item_id": "93f9aa732ba24d06953fa341d169bc1a::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Citation recall measures the proportion of factual claims that include at least one citation."}, {"item_id": "45f5fe88ee6c4386ace0a9686f88b256::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Every qb:Observation has a value for each declared attribute that is marked as required."}, {"item_id": "16c86f60e60c4a01b06c928535c9bbee::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Pos(d, a) captures the location-based weight of the source-linked text."}, {"item_id": "9b3b62e8f973448394d8e657b34c00a0::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "If a DataSet D has a qb:slice S with a qb:observation O then O's qb:dataSet must be D."}, {"item_id": "649f6351fc8b47e596956cc38cf9919d::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "The Imbalance Ratio (IR) is a numerical representation of the disparity between majority and minority class instances."}]}
